import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.rcParams['figure.figsize'] = [14, 10]
plt.rcParams['font.size'] = 12

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(constrained_layout=True, figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3)

# Subplot 1: Survival by class and sex (heatmap style bar plot)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
survival_pivot = df.groupby(['pclass', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().unstack()
survival_pivot.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], edgecolor='black')
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Gender', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_xticklabels(['First Class', 'Second Class', 'Third Class'], rotation=0)
ax1.legend(['Female', 'Male'], title='Gender')
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)
for i, (idx, row) in enumerate(survival_pivot.iterrows()):
    for j, val in enumerate(row):
        ax1.text(i + (-0.18 if j == 0 else 0.18), val + 0.02, f'{val:.1%}', 
                ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

# Subplot 2: Age distribution by survival
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
age_data = [df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].dropna(), 
            df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].dropna()]
violin_parts = ax2.violinplot(age_data, showmeans=True, showmedians=True)
colors = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4']
for i, pc in enumerate(violin_parts['bodies']):
    pc.set_facecolor(colors[i])
    pc.set_edgecolor('black')
    pc.set_alpha(0.7)
for partname in ('cbars', 'cmins', 'cmaxes', 'cmeans', 'cmedians'):
    if partname in violin_parts:
        violin_parts[partname].set_edgecolor('black')
        violin_parts[partname].set_linewidth(1)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Survival Status', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('Age', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_xticks([1, 2])
ax2.set_xticklabels(['Perished\n(n={})'.format(len(age_data[0])), 
                     'Survived\n(n={})'.format(len(age_data[1]))])
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Subplot 3: Fare distribution by class and survival
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
fare_data = []
labels = []
colors_fare = ['#FF9A76', '#FF6B6B', '#FFD166', '#4ECDC4', '#06D6A0', '#118AB2']
for pclass in [1, 2, 3]:
    for survived in [0, 1]:
        subset = df[(df['pclass'] == pclass) & (df['survived'] == survived)]['fare'].dropna()
        fare_data.append(subset)
        labels.append(f'Class {pclass}\n{"Survived" if survived else "Perished"}')
box = ax3.boxplot(fare_data, patch_artist=True, labels=labels, showfliers=False)
for patch, color in zip(box['boxes'], colors_fare):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
    patch.set_edgecolor('black')
ax3.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class and Survival', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Fare ($)', fontsize=12)
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax3.set_yscale('log')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Subplot 4: Survival by family size
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch'] + 1
family_survival = df.groupby('family_size')['survived'].agg(['mean', 'count']).reset_index()
family_survival = family_survival[family_survival['count'] >= 10]  # Filter for meaningful groups
bars = ax4.bar(family_survival['family_size'], family_survival['mean'], 
               color='#118AB2', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
ax4.set_title('Survival Rate by Family Size', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Family Size (including passenger)', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_xticks(family_survival['family_size'])
ax4.set_ylim(0, 1)
for bar, count in zip(bars, family_survival['count']):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax4.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.02,
             f'{height:.1%}\n(n={count})', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)
ax4.axhline(y=df['survived'].mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7, 
            label=f'Overall Avg: {df["survived"].mean():.1%}')
ax4.legend()

# Subplot 5: Embarkation port survival
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
embark_survival = df.groupby('embark_town')['survived'].agg(['mean', 'count']).sort_values('mean')
x_pos = np.arange(len(embark_survival))

ax5.set_xlim(0, 1)
for i, (idx, row) in enumerate(embark_survival.iterrows()):
    ax5.text(row['mean'] + 0.02, i, f'{row["mean"]:.1%}', va='center', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# Subplot 6: Alone vs with family survival

bars = ax6.bar(['With Family', 'Alone'], alone_survival['mean'],
